rule: If a name contains the male particle "Bin" (case‑insensitive) the Gender must be Male; if it contains any female particle ("Binte", "d/o", "s/o") the Gender must be Female.
rationale: The sample data includes culturally specific name particles that encode gender. Inconsistent gender assignments would indicate data quality issues.
